svg.title: A StableBear PcfTensor of Betti curves, shape (3, 2, 2)
svg.desc: A block of glass cells, 3 rows by 2 columns by 2 deep. Each cell holds one Betti curve, a step function drawn as a line. The front layer holds the H1 Betti curves and the back layer the H0 Betti curves of six point clouds: a circle, a torus, a sphere, three clusters, a helix and uniform noise.
